topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Code of conduct in the employee handbook; acceptable use policy (POL-05) signed at hire and each year; sanctions in POL-01 4.8
gap: New policy set (approved 2026-08-31) not yet acknowledged by all 60 staff
remediation: Collect POL-01 to POL-05 acknowledgments from all staff

control_description: Privately held LLC with no board. The CEO (majority owner) approves the security budget and High risk acceptances; the COO is executive owner of the program
evidence: P01 approval record 2026-08-31; FY2027 security budget
gap: No recurring oversight record: quarterly security reporting to the CEO starts 2026 Q4 (POL-01 4.12)
remediation: Quarterly security and contract-term report to the CEO and COO with minutes

control_description: IT Manager designated Information Security Officer in writing and named in agency contracts; roles and reporting lines set in POL-01 and the SSP
Commercial background checks at hire; annual awareness training; fingerprint-based checks for 9 staff through agency customers
evidence: HR files; training records; AC-02 certification copies
gap: 4 staff reached CJI and 2 reached FTI without the required screening; CJIS and FTI training gaps
remediation: POAM-001 screening gate; POAM-017 training gate before access

control_description: Sanctions for policy violations (POL-01 4.8); risk owners named in the register
gap: Security duties are not in job descriptions or annual reviews
remediation: Add security responsibilities to job descriptions and review forms

control_description: Cloud audit logs and application audit logs collected; system inventory in the SSP
gap: Logs kept 90 days and never reviewed; no complete inventory of where regulated data sits
remediation: POAM-005 log archive; POAM-014 weekly review; data inventory (POL-04 4.5)

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies published on the intranet; annual awareness training; security contact known to staff
gap: No 1-hour reporting rule until POL-03; 5 of 8 staff interviewed did not know how to report a suspected incident (P07 IR-06a.)
remediation: POAM-015 all-staff briefing and reporting channel

control_description: Security contacts and notice terms named in each agency contract; status page for agency users
gap: No customer-facing system description or statement of security commitments; no interconnection agreement with AC-03; agency incident notice procedure not yet tested
remediation: Publish a system description for agencies; AC-03 interconnection agreement; P08 tabletop

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Objectives set from agency contracts: SP 800-53 Moderate baseline, RTO 8 hours and RPO 1 hour for the large tenants, FIPS 199 categorization in the SSP
Risk assessment using SP 800-30 Rev. 1 completed 2026-07-24 and approved 2026-08-31; 32 risks with owners and treatments
Insider misuse of CJI and FTI is in the register (R-003, R-017)
gap: No assessment of fraud incentives, such as altering case or payment status for a favored person
remediation: Add a fraud and misuse assessment to the 2027 register update

control_description: POL-01 4.3 requires reassessment after major changes; POL-01 4.6 requires review within 60 days of each new CJIS Security Policy version
gap: The model service was added in May 2026 with no risk review; no trigger in the change or vendor process
remediation: Risk question in the pull request template and vendor onboarding; CJIS version review (P03 CJ-02)

control_description: First independent control assessment of 20 controls in August 2026 (P07); annual assessment required by POL-01 4.10
gap: No ongoing monitoring between assessments
remediation: Weekly scanning and managed detection feed a monthly control dashboard (POAM-007, POAM-016)

control_description: POA&M with 20 items, owners, and dates accepted by the COO; shared with AC-01 and AC-02 by 2026-12-31

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected from the SP 800-53 Moderate baseline with CJIS and Pub. 1075 overlays, documented in the SSP
Infrastructure as code, two-person pull request approval, pipeline scanning, SSO with MFA
gap: Technology controls have High gaps in backup, logging, monitoring, and privileged access
remediation: Complete the High POA&M items

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Five policies approved 2026-08-31 (P06)
gap: Supporting procedures missing: contingency plan, emergency change, data deletion at contract end
remediation: Write the three procedures

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: SSO with MFA for all staff and hardware keys for administrators; tenant separation; encryption at rest; AC-01 dedicated database with customer-managed key
evidence: Identity provider and cloud IAM exports; P07 IA-2 results (satisfied)
gap: Interface key found in a pipeline variable (rotated 2026-08-10); secrets not all in the secrets manager; 4 municipal tenants allow local accounts without MFA
remediation: POAM-011 secrets migration and mutual TLS; MFA for local accounts (P01 R-014)

control_description: New accounts approved by the user's manager
gap: Account types undocumented; no access reviews; 3 stale accounts; a shared credential
remediation: POAM-013

control_description: Role-based access in the platform and cloud
gap: Standing administrator rights to every tenant; support staff can read all tenants; unscreened staff held CJI and FTI access until the CEO's 2026-08-31 directive
remediation: POAM-001 access removal; POAM-012 just-in-time and tenant-scoped access

control_description: Data centers inherited from the FedRAMP Moderate authorized cloud provider; headquarters has badge access and holds no production systems
Laptops wiped before reuse
gap: A former municipal customer's data is still held; the 2025 staging copy of FTI was deleted with no record; no deletion certificate process
remediation: Delete with certificate (P01 R-022); contract-end procedure (POL-04 4.6)

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Web application firewall; TLS on all external endpoints; provider DDoS protection
gap: Containers can connect to any internet address
remediation: Egress allow-list (P01 R-002)

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS 1.2 or higher in transit; secure file transfer for AC-01
gap: TLS modules at ingress and gateway not in FIPS-validated mode; FTI and CJI leave the boundary in ticket screenshots
remediation: POAM-008 and POAM-009 validated modules; POAM-010 block and purge ticket attachments

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR on all laptops; dependency and image scanning in the pipeline
gap: No runtime protection for containers; images are not signed or verified at deployment
remediation: Runtime protection with POAM-016; image signing (P01 R-012)

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Static analysis and dependency scanning in the pipeline; external penetration test (October 2025)
gap: No authenticated scanning of running workloads; 2 medium penetration test findings open
remediation: POAM-016 weekly scanning and remediation deadlines

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: Performance alerts only
gap: No security monitoring or after-hours alerting; logs not reviewed
remediation: POAM-007 managed 24x7 detection; POAM-014 weekly review

control_description: Declaration criteria defined in the P08 runbook
gap: No triage of security events today (no alerts to triage); incident tracking just defined
remediation: Triage procedure with the managed detection provider

control_description: P08 runbook and notification matrix approved 2026-08-31; POL-03 sets agency notice clocks
gap: Plan never tested; forensic retainer not confirmed
remediation: POAM-018 tabletop with AC-01 and AC-02

control_description: Point-in-time database recovery and daily snapshots
gap: Backups in the production account, not immutable, and never restored end to end
remediation: POAM-003 isolated immutable backups; POAM-004 restore tests

control_description: Infrastructure as code; pull requests need two approvals; pipeline deploys
gap: 3 console changes without a ticket in 6 months; no security impact questions
remediation: POAM-019 emergency change procedure and weekly console-change report

control_description: BIA approved (P05); cyber insurance with breach hotline
gap: No contingency plan
remediation: Contingency plan from the BIA (POAM-004)

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Cloud provider's FedRAMP status checked; provider contract has security terms
gap: Ticketing vendor and model service never reviewed; ticketing vendor holds FTI and CJI without approval; cloud provider's SOC 2 report not collected
remediation: POAM-010 vendor register and annual reviews

control_description: Managed services scale automatically; performance alerts in SYS-13
gap: No documented capacity review against agency peak periods (for example tax deadlines)
remediation: Quarterly capacity review

control_description: Production runs across 3 zones in one U.S. region; environmental protection inherited from the cloud provider
gap: Backups share the production account and region and are not immutable
remediation: POAM-003

control_description: None
gap: Recovery never tested; the 8-hour contract RTO is unproven
remediation: POAM-004 quarterly restore tests and annual exercise

topic_label: Identification and maintenance of confidential information
control_description: Classification policy with a Regulated level for FTI and CJI (POL-04); FTI kept in the AC-01 tenant
gap: Inventory of Regulated data locations incomplete; caseworker-entered FTI in AC-03 notes not detected
remediation: Data inventory (POL-04 4.5); pattern alert (P01 R-030)

control_description: None beyond laptop wiping
gap: Confidential data is not disposed of at contract end
remediation: Deletion with certificate (P01 R-022); contract-end procedure
